name: Alchemist's Supplies
description: Alchemist's Supplies include two glass beakers, a metal frame, a stirring rod, a mortar and pestle, and a pouch of common alchemical ingredients. Proficiency adds your Proficiency Bonus to Intelligence checks to identify potions and poisons and to craft alchemical items such as acid or alchemist's fire. If you also have Arcana or Nature proficiency, you gain Advantage on checks using these tools.

name: Antitoxin
description: A creature that drinks this vial of liquid gains Advantage on saving throws against poison for 1 hour. It confers no benefit to Undead or Constructs.

name: Backpack
description: A leather pack carried on the back. Can hold up to 30 pounds of gear not exceeding 1 cubic foot in volume.

name: Bagpipes
description: A wind instrument with a bag reservoir and multiple pipes, known for carrying sound across great distances. Proficiency lets you use Charisma to perform and inspire others with this instrument. If you also have Performance proficiency, you gain Advantage on checks using this instrument.

name: Battleaxe
description: A single or double-headed axe with a substantial blade, favoured by warriors who want reach and power in one package.
masteryText: If you hit a creature with this weapon, you can force the creature to make a Constitution saving throw (DC 8 + proficiency bonus + attack ability modifier). On a failed save, the creature has the Prone condition.

name: Bedroll
description: You can sleep in a bedroll to gain the benefits of a Long Rest in a wilderness environment. Without a bedroll, sleeping on cold or wet ground may impose Exhaustion at the DM's discretion.

name: Blowgun
description: A hollow tube used to propel needles by breath. Beloved by assassins and hunters for its near-silent operation. Darts are often coated with poison to compensate for the weapon's low damage.
masteryText: If you hit a creature with this weapon and deal damage, you have Advantage on your next attack roll against that creature before the end of your next turn.

name: Breastplate
description: This armour consists of a fitted metal chest piece worn with supple leather. Although it leaves the legs and arms relatively unprotected, this armour provides good protection for the wearer's vital organs.

name: Brewer's Supplies
description: Brewer's Supplies include a large glass jug, a quantity of hops, a siphon, and several feet of tubing. Proficiency adds your Proficiency Bonus to Intelligence checks to craft ales and other beverages and to identify drinks and their effects. If you also have Medicine or Survival proficiency, you gain Advantage on checks using these tools.

name: Calligrapher's Supplies
description: Calligrapher's Supplies include ink, a dozen sheets of parchment, and three quills. Proficiency adds your Proficiency Bonus to Dexterity checks to craft beautiful script, decipher handwriting, and forge or authenticate documents. If you also have History or Perception proficiency, you gain Advantage on checks using these tools.

name: Carpenter's Tools
description: Carpenter's Tools include a saw, a hammer, nails, a hatchet, a square, a ruler, an adze, a plane, and a chisel. Proficiency adds your Proficiency Bonus to Strength checks to construct or assess wooden structures and objects. If you also have Perception or Stealth proficiency, you gain Advantage on checks using these tools.

name: Cartographer's Tools
description: Cartographer's Tools include a quill, ink, parchment, a pair of compasses, calipers, and a ruler. Proficiency adds your Proficiency Bonus to Intelligence checks to draft accurate maps and navigate by them. If you also have Survival or History proficiency, you gain Advantage on checks using these tools.

name: Chain Mail
description: Made of interlocking metal rings, chain mail includes a layer of quilted fabric worn underneath the mail to prevent chafing and to cushion the impact of blows. The suit includes gauntlets.

name: Chain Shirt
description: Made of interlocking metal rings, a chain shirt is worn between layers of clothing or leather. This armour offers modest protection to the wearer's upper body.

name: Climbers Kit
description: A climber's kit includes special pitons, boot tips, gloves, and a harness. As an action, you can use the climber's kit to anchor yourself; when you do, you can't fall more than 25 feet from the point where you anchored yourself, and you can't climb more than 25 feet away from that point.

name: Club
description: A simple wooden club. The most basic of weapons — cheap, easy to find, and reliable in a pinch.
masteryText: If you hit a creature with this weapon and deal damage, you can reduce that creature's Speed by 10 feet until the start of your next turn.

name: Cobbler's Tools
description: Cobbler's Tools include a hammer, an awl, a knife, a cobbler's last, spare leather, and thread. Proficiency adds your Proficiency Bonus to Dexterity checks to craft and repair footwear and modify boots for special purposes such as added grip or silent soles. If you also have Stealth or Athletics proficiency, you gain Advantage on checks using these tools.

name: Cook's Utensils
description: Cook's Utensils include a metal pot, knives, forks, a stirring spoon, and a ladle. Proficiency adds your Proficiency Bonus to Wisdom checks to prepare nourishing or restorative meals and identify ingredients and their properties. If you also have Medicine or Survival proficiency, you gain Advantage on checks using these tools.

name: Dagger
description: A short blade ideal for close quarters or throwing. Its balance makes it a favourite of rogues and those who fight in tight spaces.
masteryText: When you make the extra attack of the Light property, you can make it as part of the Attack action instead of as a Bonus Action. You can make this extra attack only once per turn.

name: Dart
description: A small weighted projectile thrown by hand. Darts are cheap, light, and easy to conceal. Many rogues and assassins keep a handful on their person at all times.
masteryText: If you hit a creature with this weapon and deal damage, you have Advantage on your next attack roll against that creature before the end of your next turn.

name: Dice Set
description: A set of small polyhedral dice used for games of chance. Proficiency adds your Proficiency Bonus to Wisdom checks to detect cheating and to employ subtle sleight of hand during games. If you also have Insight or Sleight of Hand proficiency, you gain Advantage on checks using these tools.

name: Disguise Kit
description: A disguise kit contains cosmetics, hair dye, small props, and a small mirror. Proficiency adds your Proficiency Bonus to Charisma checks to create convincing disguises and to see through others' disguises. If you also have Deception or Performance proficiency, you gain Advantage on checks using these tools.

name: Dragonchess Set
description: A three-tiered chess variant played on three boards simultaneously, representing air, land, and underground realms. Proficiency adds your Proficiency Bonus to Intelligence checks to read opponents' strategies and anticipate their moves. If you also have Investigation or Insight proficiency, you gain Advantage on checks using these tools.

name: Drum
description: A percussion instrument consisting of a hollow cylinder with a membrane stretched across one or both ends. Proficiency lets you use Charisma to perform and inspire others with this instrument. If you also have Performance proficiency, you gain Advantage on checks using this instrument.

name: Dulcimer
description: A stringed instrument played by striking the strings with small hammers, producing a bright, resonant tone. Proficiency lets you use Charisma to perform and inspire others with this instrument. If you also have Performance proficiency, you gain Advantage on checks using this instrument.

name: Flail
description: A weighted ball on a chain attached to a handle. The flexible head can wrap around shields, making it effective against heavily armoured opponents.
masteryText: If you hit a creature with this weapon, that creature has Disadvantage on its next attack roll before the start of your next turn.

name: Flute
description: A simple wind instrument played by blowing across a hole near one end, capable of bright, clear tones. Proficiency lets you use Charisma to perform and inspire others with this instrument. If you also have Performance proficiency, you gain Advantage on checks using this instrument.

name: Forgery Kit
description: A forgery kit includes several types of ink, a variety of parchments and papers, quills, wax seals, and binding materials. Proficiency adds your Proficiency Bonus to Dexterity checks to create convincing forgeries of documents and seals and to detect forgeries. If you also have Deception or History proficiency, you gain Advantage on checks using these tools.

name: Glaive
description: A long polearm with a single-edged blade. Its reach makes it devastating against enemies who can't close the distance, and its sweeping cuts can hit multiple foes.
masteryText: If your attack roll misses a creature, you can deal damage equal to your ability modifier to that creature. This damage is the same type dealt by the weapon.

name: Glassblower's Tools
description: Glassblower's Tools include a blowpipe, a marver, blocks, and tweezers. Proficiency adds your Proficiency Bonus to Intelligence checks to craft glass objects and assess the quality or flaws of glass and crystal items. If you also have History or Investigation proficiency, you gain Advantage on checks using these tools.

name: Greataxe
description: A massive double-headed axe that deals devastating damage in the hands of a powerful warrior. The weapon of choice for barbarians who favour raw power over finesse.
masteryText: If you hit a creature with a melee attack, you can make a melee attack against a second creature within 5 feet of the first that is also within your reach. On a hit, the second attack deals damage but you don't add your ability modifier unless it is negative.

name: Greatclub
description: A large, heavy bludgeon. Simple in construction but devastating in the hands of someone strong enough to wield it properly.
masteryText: If you hit a creature with this weapon, you can push the creature up to 10 feet straight away from yourself if it is Large or smaller.

name: Greatsword
description: A massive two-handed sword requiring considerable strength and training to wield effectively. Favoured by fighters and paladins who want maximum damage output.
masteryText: If your attack roll misses a creature, you can deal damage equal to your ability modifier to that creature. This damage is the same type dealt by the weapon.

name: Halberd
description: A polearm combining an axe blade with a spear point. Used by guards and soldiers, the halberd can hook mounted riders from their saddles as well as keep infantry at bay.
masteryText: If you hit a creature with a melee attack, you can make a melee attack against a second creature within 5 feet of the first that is also within your reach. On a hit, the second attack deals damage but you don't add your ability modifier unless it is negative.

name: Half Plate
description: Half plate consists of shaped metal plates that cover most of the wearer's body. It does not include leg protection beyond simple greaves attached with leather straps.

name: Hand Crossbow
description: A compact one-handed crossbow that can be used alongside a melee weapon. Expensive and awkward to reload, but invaluable for rogues who need a ranged option in hand.
masteryText: If you hit a creature with this weapon and deal damage, you have Advantage on your next attack roll against that creature before the end of your next turn.

name: Handaxe
description: A small, single-headed axe balanced for throwing or use in melee. Versatile enough for utility work around camp as well as combat.
masteryText: If you hit a creature with this weapon and deal damage, you have Advantage on your next attack roll against that creature before the end of your next turn.

name: Healer's Kit
description: A healer's kit contains bandages, salves, and splints (10 uses). As a Utilize action, expend one use to stabilise a creature at 0 Hit Points without a Wisdom (Medicine) check. Proficiency adds your Proficiency Bonus to Wisdom (Medicine) checks. If you also have Medicine proficiency, you gain Advantage on checks using these tools.

name: Healers Kit
description: A leather pouch containing bandages, salves, and splints. As an action, you can expend one use to stabilise a creature that has 0 Hit Points, without needing to make a Wisdom (Medicine) check.

name: Heavy Crossbow
description: A powerful crossbow that delivers tremendous force, capable of punching through heavy armour at range. Its slow reload speed is offset by devastating damage on a hit.
masteryText: If you hit a creature with this weapon, you can push the creature up to 10 feet straight away from yourself if it is Large or smaller.

name: Herbalism Kit
description: This kit contains clippers, a mortar and pestle, and pouches and vials for storing herbs. Proficiency adds your Proficiency Bonus to Intelligence checks to identify herbs and craft antitoxin and healing potions. If you also have Nature or Medicine proficiency, you gain Advantage on checks using these tools.

name: Hide Armour
description: This crude armour consists of thick furs and pelts. It is commonly worn by Barbarian tribes and other folk who lack access to the tools and materials needed to create better armour.

name: Horn
description: A wind instrument made from an animal horn or shaped metal, often used for signalling as well as music. Proficiency lets you use Charisma to perform and inspire others with this instrument. If you also have Performance proficiency, you gain Advantage on checks using this instrument.

name: Javelin
description: A light spear designed primarily for throwing. Soldiers have used javelins for centuries to soften up enemies before closing to melee.
masteryText: If you hit a creature with this weapon and deal damage, you can reduce that creature's Speed by 10 feet until the start of your next turn.

name: Jeweler's Tools
description: Jeweler's Tools include a small saw, a hammer, files, a magnifying glass, tweezers, and a small cup of acid. Proficiency adds your Proficiency Bonus to Intelligence checks to craft and appraise jewellery and gems and identify precious stones. If you also have Investigation or Arcana proficiency, you gain Advantage on checks using these tools.

name: Lance
description: A long cavalry weapon designed to deliver devastating charges on horseback. Unwieldy on foot but lethal when used by a mounted warrior at full gallop.
masteryText: If you hit a creature with this weapon, you can force the creature to make a Constitution saving throw (DC 8 + proficiency bonus + attack ability modifier). On a failed save, the creature has the Prone condition.

name: Lantern, Hooded
description: Burns for 6 hours on a flask of oil, shedding Bright Light in a 30-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 30 feet. As an action, you can lower the hood, reducing the light to Dim Light in a 5-foot radius.

name: Leather Armour
description: The breastplate and shoulder protectors of this armour are made of leather that has been stiffened by being boiled in oil. The rest of the armour is made of softer and more flexible materials.

name: Leatherworker's Tools
description: Leatherworker's Tools include a knife, a small mallet, an edger, a hole punch, thread, and leather scraps. Proficiency adds your Proficiency Bonus to Dexterity checks to craft and repair leather armour and goods and identify leather items and their origin. If you also have Investigation or Stealth proficiency, you gain Advantage on checks using these tools.

name: Light Crossbow
description: A mechanically-cocked ranged weapon easier to use than a longbow, though slower to reload. Popular among guards and militia for its reliability.
masteryText: If you hit a creature with this weapon and deal damage, you can reduce that creature's Speed by 10 feet until the start of your next turn.

name: Light Hammer
description: A small hammer equally suited to driving nails and cracking skulls. Its light weight lets you use it one-handed or hurl it at enemies.
masteryText: When you make the extra attack of the Light property, you can make it as part of the Attack action instead of as a Bonus Action. You can make this extra attack only once per turn.

name: Longbow
description: The preeminent military ranged weapon. A skilled longbowman can loose arrows with deadly accuracy at extreme range. English longbowmen decided battles from hundreds of yards away.
masteryText: If you hit a creature with this weapon and deal damage, you can reduce that creature's Speed by 10 feet until the start of your next turn.

name: Longsword
description: The quintessential knightly weapon. Balanced for one or two hands, the longsword is as much a symbol of martial prowess as it is a tool of war.
masteryText: If you hit a creature with this weapon, that creature has Disadvantage on its next attack roll before the start of your next turn.

name: Lute
description: A plucked stringed instrument with a pear-shaped body, the standard instrument of bards across the realms. Proficiency lets you use Charisma to perform and inspire others with this instrument. If you also have Performance proficiency, you gain Advantage on checks using this instrument.

name: Lyre
description: A plucked string instrument with a U-shaped frame, associated with ancient tradition and bardic magic. Proficiency lets you use Charisma to perform and inspire others with this instrument. If you also have Performance proficiency, you gain Advantage on checks using this instrument.

name: Mace
description: A weighted metal head atop a sturdy haft. The weapon of choice for those whose faith compels them to avoid shedding blood, since it crushes rather than cuts.
masteryText: If you hit a creature with this weapon, that creature has Disadvantage on its next attack roll before the start of your next turn.

name: Mason's Tools
description: Mason's Tools include a trowel, a hammer, a chisel, brushes, and a square. Proficiency adds your Proficiency Bonus to Strength checks to construct stone structures, assess the stability of stonework, and find weaknesses in walls. If you also have Perception or Investigation proficiency, you gain Advantage on checks using these tools.

name: Maul
description: A massive war hammer requiring two hands to swing. Favoured by those who want to crush armour and bone alike. What it lacks in elegance it more than makes up for in raw destructive power.
masteryText: If you hit a creature with this weapon, you can force the creature to make a Constitution saving throw (DC 8 + proficiency bonus + attack ability modifier). On a failed save, the creature has the Prone condition.

name: Morningstar
description: A spiked metal ball atop a handle. The spikes allow it to punch through armour that would blunt a smooth-headed mace, combining the reach of a club with armour-piercing capability.
masteryText: If you hit a creature with this weapon, that creature has Disadvantage on its next attack roll before the start of your next turn.

name: Navigator's Tools
description: Navigator's Tools include a sextant, a compass, calipers, a ruler, parchment, ink, and a quill. Proficiency adds your Proficiency Bonus to Wisdom checks to chart courses, navigate by stars, and determine your position at sea or in the wilderness. If you also have Survival or History proficiency, you gain Advantage on checks using these tools.

name: Net
description: A large mesh thrown to entangle opponents. A Large or smaller creature hit by the net has the Restrained condition until it frees itself. Freeing requires a DC 10 Strength check as an action, or the net can be cut (AC 10, 5 HP).
masteryText: If you hit a creature with this weapon and deal damage, you can reduce that creature's Speed by 10 feet until the start of your next turn.

name: Padded Armour
description: Quilted layers of cloth and batting. Cheap and easy to come by but bulky enough to hinder sneaky movement.

name: Painter's Supplies
description: Painter's Supplies include an easel, canvas, paints, brushes, charcoal sticks, and a palette. Proficiency adds your Proficiency Bonus to Wisdom checks to create or authenticate artwork and recall details about artistic styles and their origins. If you also have Insight or Perception proficiency, you gain Advantage on checks using these tools.

name: Pan Flute
description: A wind instrument made of a series of tubes of increasing length bound together, producing an airy, haunting tone. Proficiency lets you use Charisma to perform and inspire others with this instrument. If you also have Performance proficiency, you gain Advantage on checks using this instrument.

name: Pike
description: An extremely long spear used by infantry formations to hold cavalry at bay. When pikemen stand in formation, their overlapping reach creates an almost impenetrable wall of points.
masteryText: If you hit a creature with this weapon, you can push the creature up to 10 feet straight away from yourself if it is Large or smaller.

name: Plate Armour
description: Plate consists of shaped, interlocking metal plates to cover the entire body. A suit of plate includes gauntlets, heavy leather boots, a visored helmet, and thick layers of padding underneath the armour. Buckles and straps distribute the weight over the body.

name: Playing Card Set
description: A deck of illustrated cards used for a variety of games. Proficiency adds your Proficiency Bonus to Wisdom checks to detect cheating and employ card tricks. If you also have Insight or Sleight of Hand proficiency, you gain Advantage on checks using these tools.

name: Poisoner's Kit
description: A poisoner's kit includes vials, chemicals, and tools for creating and handling poisons. Proficiency adds your Proficiency Bonus to Intelligence checks to craft and identify poisons and lets you apply poison to a weapon without risking poisoning yourself. If you also have Nature or Medicine proficiency, you gain Advantage on checks using these tools.

name: Potion of Climbing
description: When you drink this potion, you gain a Climb Speed equal to your Speed for 1 hour. During this time, you have Advantage on Strength (Athletics) checks made to climb.

name: Potion of Greater Healing
description: You regain 4d4 + 4 Hit Points when you drink this potion. Drinking or administering a potion takes a Bonus Action.

name: Potion of Healing
description: You regain 2d4 + 2 Hit Points when you drink this potion. Drinking or administering a potion takes a Bonus Action.

name: Potion of Invisibility
description: This potion's container looks empty but feels as though it holds liquid. When you drink it, you have the Invisible condition for 1 hour. The effect ends early if you attack or cast a spell.

name: Potion of Speed
description: When you drink this potion, you gain the effect of the Haste spell for 1 minute (no Concentration required).

name: Potion of Superior Healing
description: You regain 8d4 + 8 Hit Points when you drink this potion. Drinking or administering a potion takes a Bonus Action.

name: Potion of Supreme Healing
description: You regain 10d4 + 20 Hit Points when you drink this potion. Drinking or administering a potion takes a Bonus Action.

name: Potter's Tools
description: Potter's Tools include potter's needles, ribs, scrapers, a knife, and calipers. Proficiency adds your Proficiency Bonus to Intelligence checks to craft ceramic objects and vessels and identify pottery and its origins. If you also have History or Investigation proficiency, you gain Advantage on checks using these tools.

name: Quarterstaff
description: A sturdy wooden staff used by travellers and warriors alike. When wielded with two hands, it deals greater damage. Many spellcasters favour it as an arcane focus.
masteryText: If you hit a creature with this weapon, you can force the creature to make a Constitution saving throw (DC 8 + proficiency bonus + attack ability modifier). On a failed save, the creature has the Prone condition.

name: Rapier
description: A slender thrusting blade favoured by duelists and nobles. The rapier rewards precision over brute force, allowing those with quick reflexes to outfight heavier-armed opponents.
masteryText: If you hit a creature with this weapon and deal damage, you have Advantage on your next attack roll against that creature before the end of your next turn.

name: Rations
description: Rations consist of dry foods suitable for extended travel, including jerky, dried fruit, hardtack, and nuts. Each pack provides one day's worth of nourishment for one person.

name: Ring Mail
description: This armour is leather armour with heavy rings sewn into it. The rings help reinforce the armour against blows from swords and axes. Ring mail is inferior to chain mail, and it's usually worn only by those who can't afford better armour.

name: Rope, Hempen
description: Has 2 Hit Points and can be burst with a DC 17 Strength check. Rope is essential for climbing, securing prisoners, binding cargo, and dozens of other adventuring tasks.

name: Rope, Silk
description: Has 2 Hit Points and can be burst with a DC 17 Strength check. Stronger and lighter than hempen rope. Favoured by rogues and climbers who need reliability at height.

name: Scale Mail
description: This armour consists of a coat and leggings (and perhaps a separate skirt) of leather covered with overlapping pieces of metal, much like the scales of a fish.

name: Scimitar
description: A curved single-edged blade designed for slashing attacks from horseback. Its curved design allows it to draw through the target, maximising the cut.
masteryText: When you make the extra attack of the Light property, you can make it as part of the Attack action instead of as a Bonus Action. You can make this extra attack only once per turn.

name: Shawm
description: A loud double-reed woodwind instrument, predecessor to the oboe, common at festivals and outdoor events. Proficiency lets you use Charisma to perform and inspire others with this instrument. If you also have Performance proficiency, you gain Advantage on checks using this instrument.

name: Shield
description: While wielding this shield, you are proficient with it. A shield can't be used in combination with a two-handed weapon.

name: Shortbow
description: A smaller bow usable on horseback or in confined spaces where a longbow would be unwieldy. Rangers and scouts favour the shortbow for its versatility.
masteryText: If you hit a creature with this weapon and deal damage, you have Advantage on your next attack roll against that creature before the end of your next turn.

name: Shortsword
description: A compact double-edged blade ideal for close quarters. Rogues and monks favour the shortsword for its combination of finesse and light weight, allowing dual-wielding with ease.
masteryText: If you hit a creature with this weapon and deal damage, you have Advantage on your next attack roll against that creature before the end of your next turn.

name: Sickle
description: A curved blade originally designed for harvesting grain. Its hook-like shape makes it surprisingly effective at catching opponents off guard.
masteryText: When you make the extra attack of the Light property, you can make it as part of the Attack action instead of as a Bonus Action. You can make this extra attack only once per turn.

name: Sling
description: A simple strip of leather used to hurl stones at high speed. Cheap, easy to make, and devastatingly effective in practiced hands.
masteryText: If you hit a creature with this weapon and deal damage, you can reduce that creature's Speed by 10 feet until the start of your next turn.

name: Smith's Tools
description: Smith's Tools include hammers, tongs, a punch, a chisel, and a whetstone. Proficiency adds your Proficiency Bonus to Strength checks to craft and repair metal weapons, armour, and equipment, and to assess the quality of metalwork. If you also have Arcana or Athletics proficiency, you gain Advantage on checks using these tools.

name: Spear
description: One of the oldest weapons in existence — a sharpened point on a long shaft. Simple to make and deadly in disciplined hands.
masteryText: If you hit a creature with this weapon, that creature has Disadvantage on its next attack roll before the start of your next turn.

name: Splint Armour
description: This armour is made of narrow vertical strips of metal riveted to a backing of leather that is worn over cloth padding. Flexible chain mail protects the joints.

name: Studded Leather
description: Made from tough but flexible leather, studded leather is reinforced with close-set rivets or spikes.

name: Thieves' Tools
description: Thieves' Tools include a small file, a set of lock picks, a small mirror on a metal handle, a set of narrow-bladed scissors, and a pair of pliers. Proficiency lets you add your Proficiency Bonus to Dexterity checks to pick locks and disarm mechanical traps. If you also have Sleight of Hand proficiency, you gain Advantage on checks using these tools.

name: Three-Dragon Ante Set
description: A popular tavern card game played throughout the Forgotten Realms; each card depicts one of the dragon types. Proficiency adds your Proficiency Bonus to Wisdom checks to read opponents and bluff convincingly. If you also have Insight or Deception proficiency, you gain Advantage on checks using these tools.

name: Tinderbox
description: This small container holds flint, fire steel, and tinder used to kindle a fire. Using it to light a torch — or anything else with abundant, exposed fuel — takes a Bonus Action. Lighting any other fire takes 1 minute.

name: Tinker's Tools
description: Tinker's Tools include a variety of hand tools, thread, needles, a whetstone, scraps of cloth and leather, and a small pot of glue. Proficiency adds your Proficiency Bonus to Dexterity checks to craft and repair small mechanisms and devices and to construct or dismantle traps. If you also have Investigation or Stealth proficiency, you gain Advantage on checks using these tools.

name: Torch
description: Burns for 1 hour, shedding Bright Light in a 20-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 20 feet. If you make a melee attack with a burning torch and hit, it deals 1 Fire damage.

name: Trident
description: A three-pronged spear associated with sea gods and gladiatorial combat. The multiple points make it effective at catching and controlling an opponent's weapon or shield.
masteryText: If you hit a creature with this weapon, you can force the creature to make a Constitution saving throw (DC 8 + proficiency bonus + attack ability modifier). On a failed save, the creature has the Prone condition.

name: Viol
description: A bowed stringed instrument held between the knees, prized for its rich, resonant tone. Proficiency lets you use Charisma to perform and inspire others with this instrument. If you also have Performance proficiency, you gain Advantage on checks using this instrument.

name: War Pick
description: A pick-shaped weapon designed to punch through plate armour. The narrow point concentrates all the force of the blow into a tiny area, defeating even heavy armour.
masteryText: If you hit a creature with this weapon, that creature has Disadvantage on its next attack roll before the start of your next turn.

name: Warhammer
description: A single-headed hammer used by warriors and clerics alike. Its weight delivers crushing blows that can dent armour and break bones even when it doesn't punch through.
masteryText: If you hit a creature with this weapon, you can push the creature up to 10 feet straight away from yourself if it is Large or smaller.

name: Waterskin
description: Holds 4 pints of liquid. A character needs about 1 gallon (8 pints) of water per day, or twice as much in hot weather.

name: Weaver's Tools
description: Weaver's Tools include thread, needles, and scraps of cloth. Proficiency adds your Proficiency Bonus to Dexterity checks to craft cloth and clothing, repair garments, and identify fabric quality and origin. If you also have Insight or Stealth proficiency, you gain Advantage on checks using these tools.

name: Whip
description: A long leather lash that can strike at range and entangle limbs. In skilled hands the whip can disarm opponents or trip them before they can close to melee range.
masteryText: If you hit a creature with this weapon and deal damage, you can reduce that creature's Speed by 10 feet until the start of your next turn.

name: Woodcarver's Tools
description: Woodcarver's Tools include a knife, a gouge, and a small saw. Proficiency adds your Proficiency Bonus to Dexterity checks to craft wooden objects and decorative carvings and identify wood types and their properties. If you also have Nature or Perception proficiency, you gain Advantage on checks using these tools.
